0.why: src/TL_Reseter.cpp updateLightsAndTriggers: fabs(getVoltage()) > 1.f, so the sign is discarded

comment: The gate test is fabs(getVoltage()) > 1.f rather than a Schmitt trigger, so a voltage below -1V also reads as high; negative is marked ignored in the sense that the sign is thrown away, not the voltage. Reset is delivered through Rack's expander message system and not as a jack, so the neighbour must be a TL_Seq4 and must be directly adjacent. Nothing in this plugin saves state to the patch, so nothing here is carried over on load.
